            <description>Apple (AAPL) is preparing to fight a UK push to open iPhone tap-to-pay to rival wallets, the Financial Times reported on Friday, October 16. The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) is set to publish consultation proposals that would let iPhone users choose a wallet other than Apple Pay for contactless payments.</description>
